title: Urinary Incontinence & Dyssynergia
desc: Sphincter incompetence versus reflex dyssynergia — Proin, DES and Incurin for females; tamsulosin, prazosin and bethanechol for males; plus how the residual urine volume tells the two apart.

meds.name: Proin
meds.note: 1–1.5 mg/kg q 8–24 h. This is the drug for sphincter INCOMPETENCE — it is the wrong drug for reflex dyssynergia and will make that worse.

meds.name: DES
freqs: daily for 5 to 7 days, then once or twice weekly
meds.note: A total dose per dog, not mg/kg. Load daily for 5–7 days, then drop to once or twice weekly.

meds.name: Incurin
freqs: daily for 2 weeks, then taper to the lowest effective dose
meds.note: A total dose per dog, not mg/kg.

meds.name: Tamsulosin
meds.note: 0.01–0.2 mg/kg q 24 h. Fewer side effects and less hypotension than prazosin. Relaxes the INTERNAL urethral sphincter only; prazosin relaxes internal and external.

meds.name: Prazosin
meds.desc: alpha blocker — relaxes internal and external sphincter
meds.chartNote: 1 mg q 8 h under 30 lb; 2 mg q 8 h over 30 lb.
meds.note: Relaxes both the internal and external sphincter. More hypotension than tamsulosin.

meds.name: Bethanechol
meds.desc: contracts the bladder so it can empty
meds.chartNote: Small dog 5 mg TID, medium dog 10 mg TID, large dog 15 mg TID.
meds.note: Contracts the bladder so it empties instead of overflowing. Dyssynergia needs TWO drugs — bethanechol to empty the bladder, plus an alpha blocker to relax the sphincter.

meds.name: Diazepam
freqs: every 8 hours, or 30 minutes before voiding
meds.note: Give 30 minutes before voiding if being used situationally rather than around the clock.

notes.Tell the two apart first: If the residual urine volume after voiding is greater than 1 ml/kg, reflex dyssynergia is likely. Sphincter incompetence gets Proin; reflex dyssynergia gets prazosin plus bethanechol. Giving Proin for dyssynergia makes it worse.
notes.Measuring residual volume: Estimate from ultrasound: L × W × Ht × 0.2 × π, or L × W × H × 0.63 (cm, giving ml). A fully voided bladder should hold about 1 ml/kg.
notes.Two conditions in male dogs: 1) Sphincter dyssynergia — neurological damage to bladder and sphincter causing paralysis of the bladder wall and spasm of the urinary sphincter, producing overflow incontinence and dribbling. 2) Sphincter incompetence — weakness in the sphincter's ability to hold urine back, the opposite problem, treated with hormones and alpha-1 agonists like PPA. In male dogs, especially older ones, it is most often the first.
notes.Dyssynergia needs two drugs: Bethanechol (Urecholine) to contract the bladder so it empties instead of overflowing, PLUS prazosin or a similar alpha blocker to relax the urinary sphincter. One without the other does not work.
notes.Where the lesion is: Dyssynergia follows lesions along the lumbosacral region — spondylitis and similar.
notes.Sphincter coverage: Flomax relaxes the internal urethral sphincter. Prazosin relaxes internal and external.

dischargeBlocks.title: What is causing the leaking
dischargeBlocks.text:
There is more than one reason a dog leaks urine, and they need opposite treatments — which is why we examined {name} and measured how much urine was left behind after urinating.

In some dogs the valve holding urine in has become weak. In others the bladder itself cannot squeeze properly and the urine overflows. The medication we have chosen matches which one {name} has.

dischargeBlocks.title: This is not a house-training problem
dischargeBlocks.text:
{name} is not being disobedient and is very likely unaware it is happening — most leaking occurs while asleep or resting.

Please do not scold {name} for wet bedding. Washable bedding, or a waterproof cover, makes life easier for everyone while the medication takes effect.

dischargeBlocks.title: What to watch for
dischargeBlocks.text:
- Straining to urinate, or producing only small amounts
- A hard or painful belly
- Blood in the urine, or a strong smell
- Restlessness and repeated squatting with little coming out

A dog that cannot pass urine at all is an emergency — call us straight away.

dischargeBlocks.title: Side effects to tell us about
dischargeBlocks.text:
- Restlessness, panting, or a racing heart
- Loss of appetite
- Wobbliness or weakness, especially standing up

Some of these medications affect blood pressure, so please tell us rather than adjusting the dose yourself.

dischargeBlocks.title: Follow up
dischargeBlocks.text: Please book the recheck we discussed. It is normal to need a dose adjustment before we get the leaking fully under control — keep a note of how often it happens so we have something to compare.
